headword: {国立国会図書館|こくりつこっかいとしょかん}
reading: こくりつこっかいとしょかん

definitions.gloss: the National Diet Library (Japan's national library)
definitions.explanation: Japan's national library, in Nagatachō, Tokyo, with a branch in Kyoto. It serves the Diet (parliament) and the public, and by law receives a copy of every book and periodical published in Japan. Often shortened to {国会図書館|こっかいとしょかん}.

examples.english: To do research at the National Diet Library.

examples.english: With the National Diet Library's digital collections, you can read old books even from home.

notes:
⟦{国立|こくりつ}→国立：04153_kokuritsu⟧ (national) + ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧ (the Diet) + ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧ (library). Usually called {国会図書館|こっかいとしょかん} for short.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Because every Japanese publication must be deposited there ({納本|のうほん}), it is the place to find a book no other library has. Only adults (18 and over) may use the reading rooms, and books are read on site, not borrowed.
